<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI Policy Shift:</strong> The RBI hiked the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% and shifted to a calibrated tightening stance, with analysts anticipating further hikes to reach a terminal rate of 6.0%.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxOaHBfZmwzZ055OFBsUE9MSXRWUUhHalh4bHlrUnpDZmhSZ2w1dEU0bG8xQkFwWTd1SFgxQ2ppbHRGQzBOQ1BHdWFLcU9qRkVQenJLSnZfVUNpWVhFYWVzWmRRNnBYRWtqVGUwYkJRaEhWaG1TRFN1a1ZBRU9iTXBFcVN1NkE5NVFfUlZuTXNoNVJnNWJYU2gzTFhhclBBZw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxPTllLMmNLTFlvSlA4THZQUkZpM2Vxc2hER2pzOFVEY3RnSjVmTFRhaW10V0xzLWJ4dm9wenF3QzY4cXEyTlJPSjBzbVZpN0MzN1hmaHZadzVKOVFMRmdpaTRDRldFYVliU25OSjF4U1l2bk12c3FPTUFXQnRGcXBfNlM2Y2pjTHZGSzBzb2FRVDNvWTRtZmRJaUNB?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I19</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Volatility and Recovery:</strong> Despite hitting multi-month lows earlier this week amid significant FII outflows, the Sensex and Nifty have shown signs of recovery, bolstered by strong earnings from the IT sector.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxOWUo1MktjdERUMGllVnVOZ2VlLUpxTUhXM0M3MzAxTnFVWXFOMUl6aW1MbDVpc1B4ZXY4VGZyTk1kU1E2VDNvWnJfZ2tScDVuT0ZPM0hnS25XTUktb1hQdjdyU2ZXM0J1MHBnbW1mZEhRVW56Um1OQmhPek5XSDM3ZTBBc245YXZMcXBDQTZNZU9HOFBHdXZla3BpS3ZmNmkwS25Z?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Rupee Defense Measures:</strong> To stabilize the rupee, the RBI has intervened by selling dollars via oil marketing companies and implementing measures to curb speculative forex trading.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Sentiment:</strong> Global markets are showing resilience with Wall Street posting weekly gains as investors await further inflation data and earnings reports.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Crude Oil Impact:</strong> A cooling in crude oil prices has provided relief to Indian markets, helping to snap an eight-week losing streak for the benchmark indices.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-IN&amp;gl=IN&amp;ceid=IN%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
</ul>
